full_judgment: 6. Mr. Syed Haider Ali learned Advocate, appearing for the plaintiff-opposite-party, submits in this way "kolonka mochoner jonny" DNA test is required. Learned Advocate further submits that, although there is no official document to prove the marriage between plaintiff and defendant but to constitute valid marriage no ceremony is required, no registration is required, marriage can he presumed by evidence of conduct and reputation and question of consummation forms often an important element in the status of valid marriage. Learned Advocate further submits that, where there has been prolonged and continuous cohabitation as husband and wife, in the absence of direct proof a presumption arise that there was a valid marriage. Learned Advocate further submits that the law permits no specific ceremony for the contractual performance of a marriage and no religious rites are necessary for contracting a valid marriage. Learned Advocate relied on the case of Shafiqul Huq (Md.) vs. Mina Begum, 54 DLR-481. Learned Advocate further submits that once the marriage is consummated and the parties have cohabited, the contractual defect is removed and the marriage is declared to be legitimate.
